login_email.subject: Your Upcycling sign-in link
login_email.body:
Hello!

To sign in to Upcycling, open this link on the device where you requested it:
{link}

If you are using the app installed on your Home Screen, enter this code instead:
{code}

The link and code are valid for {minutes} min and can be used only once.
If you did not request this email, you can safely ignore it.
